item.title: Rapid7 Analysis: VMware vCenter SRP Authentication Bypass to Root (CVE-2026-123890)
item.description: Overview An unauthenticated attacker can retrieve the session key for an in-progress administrator login to VMware vCenter's directory service. The attacker then uses that key to complete the login without knowing the account's password. The vulnerable interface is exposed through DCE/RPC on TCP port 2012. The issue, tracked as CVE-2026-123890 , combines a Secure Remote Password (SRP) session-key getter that is callable before authentication with an RPC context lookup that does not enforce ownership. item.title: Elastic puts AI agents to work on the SOC alert backlog
item.description: Elastic announced Elastic Security 9.6, which introduces AlertZero, a set of AI agents that triage alerts, hunt threats and tune detection rules in the background. The release also adds ransomware protection for Linux, expanded entity resolution and an expanded set of 143 detection rules covering AI agents and large language model platforms.
